metadata.description: Small sound-v2 end-to-end feasibility run for MNIST
notes: This pilot is isolated from the article experiment outputs.
MNIST epsilon is expressed in raw pixel units, so eps=1.0 corresponds to 1/255 after normalization.
The network-scope harness verifies the deployed integer program directly and includes exact integer interval invariants.
The selected sample is correctly classified and has a high clean margin under the repository's mnist_1blk_10 weights.
The paper-z3 profile is selected because Bitwuzla timed out on this exact harness while Z3 discharged it.
TIMEOUT or MEMOUT is a scalability outcome and does not mean that the robustness property is false.

runs.name: mnist_1blk10_e2e_z3_sample3_eps1
runs.notes: Single high-margin feasibility region. Scale to additional samples and architectures only after this query's time and memory are known.

runs.name: mnist_2blk10_e2e_z3_sample3_eps1
runs.notes: Enabled depth-scaling step with approximately the same MAC count as 1blk_10.

runs.name: mnist_1blk25_e2e_z3_sample3_eps1
runs.notes: First disabled width-scaling step; enable explicitly after 2blk_10_10 completes.

runs.name: mnist_1blk10_e2e_no_invariants_z3_sample3_eps1
runs.notes: Solver ablation only. It proves the same E2E property but omits sound intermediate range assumptions.

runs.name: mnist_1blk10_derived_blocks_z3_sample3_eps1
runs.notes: Compositional ablation at the same fixed F=8. Bitwuzla is retained for the layer-block formula shape; shared-QIF neuron blocks are sound, but box abstraction may prevent certification.
